note: SCA52 is recognized as an early-onset cerebellar ataxia associated with RAB3A, fitting within nonprogressive or indolent congenital ataxia presentations similar to SCA29.

evidence.text: OMIM entry #621535 designates Spinocerebellar Ataxia 52 as being caused by variants in RAB3A, expanding the spectrum from cerebellar ataxia to spastic paraplegia.

source.title: Entry - #621535 - SPINOCEREBELLAR ATAXIA 52; SCA52
source.quote: Expanding the clinical spectrum of RAB3A: from cerebellar ataxia to spastic paraplegia. ... SPINOCEREBELLAR ATAXIA 52; SCA52.

evidence.text: Nonprogressive congenital ataxias (NPCA) feature infantile or early-onset ataxia preceded by muscular hypotonia and delayed motor milestones, with static courses overlapping across dominant genes like ITPR1.

source.title: Nonprogressive congenital ataxias
source.quote: The terminology of nonprogressive congenital ataxia (NPCA) refers to a clinically and genetically heterogeneous group of disorders characterized by congenital or early-onset ataxia, but no progression or even improvement on follow-up. Ataxia is preceded by muscular hypotonia and delayed motor (and usually language) milestones.
